Maps fd_map error codes to short error strings.

# Purpose
This file defines [`fd_map_strerror`](<#fd_map_strerror>), a small helper function that converts `fd_map` error codes into short text strings. The function uses a `switch` statement to map each known value, such as `FD_MAP_SUCCESS`, `FD_MAP_ERR_INVAL`, and `FD_MAP_ERR_FULL`, to a fixed string. If the input code does not match any known case, the function returns `"unknown"`.
